risk_if_not_implemented: Without AI & Autonomous Technologies System Value Chain, AI and autonomous systems may produce unreliable, biased or unsafe outputs, act outside authorized scope, or expose sensitive data. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unperformed / Unowned Control Responsibilities (R-GV-3), Inability to Demonstrate Due Diligence / Due Care (R-GV-9), and most likely increases susceptibility to Human Error (MT-9).

compensating_control_1.name: Third-Party Management
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of third-party management controls.
compensating_control_1.justification: Third-Party Management (TPM-02) provides third-party oversight that compensates for the absence of AI & Autonomous Technologies System Value Chain (AAT-37) by extending security obligations contractually and monitoring third-party risk in lieu of direct control. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Supply Chain Risk Management (SCRM) Plan
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to develop a plan for Supply Chain Risk Management (SCRM) associated with the development, acquisition, maintenance and disposal of Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS), including documenting selected mitigating actions and monitoring performance against those plans.
compensating_control_2.justification: Supply Chain Risk Management (SCRM) Plan (RSK-20) provides risk identification and prioritization that compensates for the absence of AI & Autonomous Technologies System Value Chain (AAT-37) by enabling informed decisions about where to focus resources to manage residual exposure. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
